- Decision on senior IC (row 42): closed at band 2 (middle ground). Reason: evidence of cross-team impact but inconsistent strategic scope. Conditions: six-month impact review and documented coaching plan. Vivek will draft the plan; Laura will add the check-in language to the HR packet.
- Engineering outlier (Connor's case): agreed to keep manager's upward recommendation contingent on measurable deliverables (two infra milestones) in next quarter. Connor to own milestones; Marissa to validate OKRs.
- Product PM spread: normalized to manager median after adjusting for scope; managers asked to surface any appeals by end of month.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Vivek: draft coaching plan for senior IC and submit to Laura by Fri 10/09 5pm PT.
- Laura: assemble redline_summary.pdf and exception packet, submit to Acme contact (Sarah) by Mon 10/12.
- Connor: publish infra milestones in OKR board and notify Marissa by 10/15.
- All leads: final appeals to People Ops by 10/31.

I'll put the meeting minutes and the final redline_summary.pdf in the Drive link and notify People Ops. If anyone disagrees with the summary please reply-all with specifics by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — appreciate the quick alignment.
